name: High School Student Summer Volunteer
city: Miami, Kendall, Plantation and Coral Gables area, FL
what_you_do: Greet and guide patients, help them use elevators and get rides in the main lobby and clinics. This is a summer placement.
who_can_apply: Students at least 16 during the application window. You must pass an interview, background check, drug screen, health checks and training.
duration: At least 5 weeks, 4 to 5 hours a day (June 16 to Aug 7 in 2026)
deadline_text: For 2026, applications were open Feb 1 to April 1, 2026. The page says the summer application is now closed. No 2027 window is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online Volunteer Services form for high school students. If you have questions, call 305-243-4032 or send an email to IHSVolunteer@miami.edu.
notes: Incomplete applications were not reviewed. The same site lists a High School Student Research Trainee role that was not read.
